ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigation into Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, with a focus on following the money and uncovering the extent of the problem
questions: What are the most common types of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How much money is being lost to Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: This story would involve analyzing data and public records to uncover the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and to identify patterns and trends. It would also involve interviewing experts and officials to gain a deeper understanding of the issue and to identify potential solutions.
